reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Ten Locales and Improved Placement
reddit.body: We're thrilled to announce significant updates in Provincia! Our build UI now supports ten languages, enhancing accessibility for players around the globe. Additionally, we've improved placement feedback to clearly indicate why certain placements fail, reducing frustration. Lastly, day and night transitions are now smoother, ensuring your colony runs efficiently without interruptions. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
